recognize_zh: 箭頭指向中性球兩個核葉之間的小型染色質突起／細絲連接處，形成像小結節或小鉤狀的附屬物，大小遠小於鼓槌體，屬於正常中性球的核附屬物變異。
features: Mature segmented neutrophil with four nuclear lobes
Small chromatin projection at the junction between two lobes (arrow)
Projection lacks the rounded head and slender stalk of a drumstick
Pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background red cells and occasional platelets unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature neutrophil with four nuclear lobes connected by chromatin filaments and pale cytoplasm containing fine neutrophilic granules. A small chromatin projection is present near the junction of two lobes (arrow), without the rounded head and thin stalk of a drumstick. No toxic granulation, vacuoles or Döhle bodies are seen. Findings represent a nuclear appendage in a normal neutrophil, a benign morphologic variant.

ddx.vs: Drumsticks are discrete ~1.5 µm round heads on a thin stalk projecting outward from a lobe, whereas this projection is small and irregular at a lobe junction.
These are other nonspecific appendage shapes of similar significance, distinguished only descriptively, and none carries pathologic meaning.
Apoptotic cells show dense, round, separated pyknotic nuclear fragments and condensed cytoplasm rather than a small tag on otherwise normal lobes.
